title: The answer key keeps uncorrected cross-sheet reference errors in graded Line Item Metrics cells, so an agent that fixes them scores 0
evidence: The task is called 'Incorrect Cross Sheet References' and asks the agent to 'audit and fix this file thoroughly … broken cell references'. The GT corrects only 4 rows of reference errors: BS J22:N22, CFS D15:H15, DCF C15:G15 and LBO E5:I5. It leaves the same kind of error in Line Item Metrics, which is graded through 'Line Item Metrics'!A2:I35. LIM columns map C=2015 … H=2020, I=2021. Balance Sheet columns map C=2014 … I=2020, J=2021, K=2022. GT LIM!H35 (2020 Net PP&E to Sales) is "='Balance Sheet'!J22/'Line Item Metrics'!H12", which uses 2021 PP&E of 716.30 instead of 2020 PP&E of 724.94 at BS!I22. GT LIM!I35 (2021) is "='Balance Sheet'!K22/…I12", which uses 2022 PP&E. Row 24 (ROA) shifts the same way: H24 =H14/AVERAGE('Balance Sheet'!H27:J27) averages three years, and I24 averages J27:K27, i.e. 2021-22 for 2021. Row 27 C..H reads BS columns C..H (2014-2019) for the 2015-2020 columns, while I27 reads J (2021). H35, I35 and I24 are modification cells: their GT values (0.570066, 0.538610, 0.021317) differ from the input. The verifier passes only when every modification cell matches (mod_ratio must be 1.0). Correcting H35 to BS!I22/H12 therefore fails the single all-or-nothing verifier (weight 1).
confirmation: LIM row 11 maps H=2020 and BS row 12 maps I=2020/J=2021, yet GT H35 is ='Balance Sheet'!J22/H12 (G35 correctly uses H22). H24 averages H27:J27, and these modification cells change value because BS J22 changes, so correcting them fails.

M27:N27, as C24:G24), C27:H27 -> same-year Balance Sheet column (D..I, as I27), H35:M35 -> same-year Net PP&E (BS I22 ... N22, as C35:G35); 'DCF'!C29 and 'Sources & Uses'!E13 =-'Balance Sheet'!I55 (comprehensive income, 6.889) -> 0 (the balance sheet has no minority-interest line). 390 cached values recomputed with the verifier's LibreOffice recalc and written at XML level (Summary!H12 58.593 -> 58.800, the value the thorough run 2 produced); answer_position: the earlier drop of the Line Item Metrics cells is reverted (they are now fixed in the key); dropped instead are 'Income Statement'!J29:J33 (unusual items projected off mixed columns; projecting 0 or the latest year are both defensible), 'Cash Flow Statement'!E28 and E30 (hardcoded 0 issuance after year 1, arguably correct as is) and 'DCF'!L17:P21, L25:P29 (pasted sensitivity grids, no single correct rebuild). The prompt scope sentence from the earlier fix is removed.

This produces operating working capital of 45.28395 instead of 22.980531 million using the corresponding 2021 balance-sheet figures. Additionally, 'Income Statement'!N26 references the empty 'PP&E, Debt, NWC'!I73 and reports zero 2025 interest despite outstanding senior notes and 90.617718 million of scheduled interest. Controlled verifier tests correcting these retained fixture errors failed: correcting working-capital references produced modification ratio 0.4532; correcting interest-year references produced 0.7389. The sole verifier has weight 1 and requires every modification cell to match, so these legitimate audit corrections receive zero overall credit.

title: Golden workbook gt_04_golden.xlsx leaves multiple broken cross-sheet references unfixed, penalizing thorough fixes required by the prompt
evidence:
The prompt instructs the agent: 'Please audit and fix this file thoroughly. Errors may include but are not limited to: formula logic errors or inconsistencies, hardcoded values that should be formulas, broken cell references...' However, comparing `untouched_input_Incorrect Cross Sheet References_input.xlsx` against `gt_04_golden.xlsx` shows that `gt_04_golden.xlsx` only fixes 4 cross-sheet reference ranges (`Balance Sheet!J22:N22`, `Cash Flow Statement!D15:H15`, `DCF!C15:G15`, and `LBO Analysis!E5:I5`) while leaving several blatant cross-sheet reference bugs unfixed in the golden solution itself:
1. `Income Statement!J26:N26` (Projected Interest Expense for 2021-2025) references `-'PP&E, Debt, NWC'!E73:I73` instead of `-'PP&E, Debt, NWC'!D73:H73` (shifted by 1 column because `PP&E, Debt, NWC!D65:H66` links to `'Income Statement'!I11:M12` [2020-2024] even though `D73:H73` sum 2021-2025 interest `D61:H61 + L61:P61`, and `I73` is blank). In `gt_04_golden.xlsx`, this makes 2025 Interest Expense (`Income Statement!N26`) equal `0` and causes `Line Item Metrics!M29` (2025 EBIT / Interest) to evaluate to `#DIV/0!`.
2. `PP&E, Debt, NWC!C81:M83` (Inventory, Accounts Payable, and Accrued Expenses in the 2015-2025 Operating Working Capital schedule) references `'Balance Sheet'!C17:M17`, `C29:M29`, and `C30:M30` (2014-2024, shifted left by 1 year/column relative to the 2015-2025 headers in `C79:M79` and relative to `C80:M80` Accounts Receivable which references `D15:N15`). Because `DCF!C19:G19` (`Changes in NWC`) pulls from `PP&E, Debt, NWC!H84:M84`, this 1-year column shift corrupts DCF Free Cash Flow (`DCF!C20:G20`), Implied Share Price (`DCF!C32` and `Summary!H12`), and LBO cash sweep/interest (`LBO Analysis!E23:I42`).
3. `Line Item Metrics!H24:M24` (Return on assets) and `H35:M35` (Net PP&E to Sales) skip column `I` (2020) on `Balance Sheet` and run into blank column `O` for 2025, while `DCF!C29` and `Sources & Uses!E13` (`Minority Interest`) reference `-'Balance Sheet'!I55` (`Comprehensive Income. And Other` = `-6.889`).
Because `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (weight: 1) requires `mod_ratio == 1.0` and `reg_ratio >= 0.998` against `gt_04_golden.xlsx`, fixing these genuine broken cross-sheet references causes ~190-220 cell mismatches and a score of `0.0` (as happened in all 3 runs).
confirmation: Verified the GT leaves IS N26 pointing at blank I73 (2025 interest = 0) and PP&E C81:M83 one year behind the C79 headers and C80 receivables (BS D15). It also leaves LIM H35 using BS J22 (2021) for 2020. A thorough audit that fixes these fails the all-or-nothing check.

title: The open-ended 'audit thoroughly' prompt is graded all-or-nothing against exactly 4 planted fixes, so legitimate extra fixes are penalized
evidence: The instruction lists 'hardcoded values that should be formulas … inconsistent formatting or naming conventions, best practice violations, and any other issues'. The verifier compares values in mode 'values' across 5,509 cells. It needs 100% of modification cells and ≥99.8% of regression cells (roughly 10 cells of slack) to match the GT, which changes only 21 formulas. The workbook has many other things an auditor could reasonably 'fix' that cascade into graded values. Examples: the DCF sensitivity grids L17:P21 and L25:P29 are hardcoded numbers (a 'hardcode that should be a formula'). Income Statement projections J29 =$G29, J30 =$F30, J31 =$H31 and J33 =$H33 point at inconsistent historical columns, and J32 is blank. Cash Flow Statement E28/E30 are hardcoded 0 where the neighbouring cells are formulas. Changing any upstream item that moves the cash flow, balance sheet or DCF values breaks many modification cells and scores 0. Formatting and naming fixes, which the prompt explicitly asks for, are never graded. The scope the prompt asks for does not match the scope that is graded.
confirmation: The prompt asks for a thorough audit of all error types, but the GT changes only 21 formulas in 4 ranges while leaving verifiable reference errors in place. All 3 runs that fixed additional real errors scored 0 under the binary verifier.

title: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check fails all three valid attempts (score 0.0) because gt_04_golden.xlsx retains unfixed cross-sheet reference errors
evidence: Across all 3 units, `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (weight: 1) returned `score=0` (`unit 1`: `regression 0.9881, modification 0.3547, 194 cell error(s)`; `unit 2`: `regression 0.9844, modification 0.3251, 220 cell error(s)`; `unit 3`: `regression 0.9857, modification 0.3547, 207 cell error(s)`). Reconstructing the outputs from the trajectories confirms that all 3 units found and fixed all 4 cross-sheet reference bugs differentiated in `gt_04_golden.xlsx` (`Balance Sheet!J22:N22`, `Cash Flow Statement!D15:H15`, `DCF!C15:G15`, `LBO Analysis!E5:I5`), and also fixed the genuine cross-sheet column-shift bugs that `gt_04_golden.xlsx` left broken: `Income Statement!J26:N26` (`=-'PP&E, Debt, NWC'!D73:H73` instead of `E73:I73`, which in `gt_04_golden.xlsx` shifted 2021-2024 interest by 1 year and left 2025 interest at `0`) and `PP&E, Debt, NWC!C81:M83` (`='Balance Sheet'!D17:N17`, `D29:N29`, `D30:N30` instead of `C17:M17`, `C29:M29`, `C30:M30`, which in `gt_04_golden.xlsx` pulled 2014-2024 balances into the 2015-2025 columns). Applying those exact fixes to `gt_04_golden.xlsx` reproduces `Summary!H12 = 58.592701413954`, `Summary!H13 = 0.253319816341263`, `Income Statement!J26 = -161.996818046479`, and `Income Statement!J28 = 16.5981708761683` identically to `unit 1` and `unit 3` (and in `unit 2`, additionally fixing `DCF!C29` / `Sources & Uses!E13` from `-'Balance Sheet'!I55` [Comprehensive Income] to `0` increases `Summary!H12` by `6.889 / 33.307406 = 0.20683088` to `58.7995322911469`). Thus, the verifier falsely fails every unit that thoroughly fixes the broken cross-sheet references as instructed.
